relationship_notes: Strongly documented independent early British fuzz maker. Fuzzboxes reports workshop construction and public sales by late 1965/early 1966. Baldwin-Burns copied the Harmonic Generator later; keep that design relationship separate from builder identity.

Retail advertisement alone does not establish manufacture. Fuzzboxes explicitly says Clifford may have been supplied by a small builder or may simply have stocked another maker's products. Keep as retail/distribution history only.
